_comment: INTERMEZZO — the doorframe between theGodInUrhead and nice_ron. nice_ron's opening narration, given a room of its own so the song can simply start grazing. No groove: theGodInUrhead's music box walks in still playing boxtoforest (its own bridge — the box already quotes nice_ron's bell cell, in E minor), a soft E-minor hush beneath it, the line speaks, then the pad settles onto nice_ron's exact opening chord [e3,g3,b3] while the forest bells take the box's phrase over. Four bars each side — a room, not a blink. One voice line, sized to its clip (reused from nice_ron line-01, no re-render).

sections.label: the doorframe — the music box has wandered into the forest
nature was a gift once — and it made us happy
toward the meadow — the bells take the phrase, the deer are already grazing
